fields.title: Sepsis after surgery

decisions.question: What do you do now?
decisions.answer: Call rapid response and report with SBAR; stay with the patient
decisions.rationale: The safest first move is to bring help while staying with the patient and giving a structured report.

decisions.question: What belongs in the handoff?
decisions.rationale: A structured handoff has all four elements and ends with a read-back.

fields.scoreNote: Scores use this app's own scale. They are not NCLEX scores.
